calls.bash: mu agent spawn gate -w eval --command "ssh dev -t remote-gate" --no-ctl
mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --host dev --worktree --task g1 --send 'do g1; mu is not on this host' --json
out=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval); rev=$(echo "$out" | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; mu agent collect w1 -w eval
rev=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$rev" ]; then mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; fi
mu task close g1 -w eval --evidence 'g1 worker finished on dev (DONE: g1)'

text: The gate finished, g1 ran on dev and is merged, and the report is written.
